title: A canonical map from the derived tensor product of an internal hom with its first variable into the internal hom of the internal homs
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for a ringed site and objects K, L, M of the derived category, a canonical morphism from R-Hom(L, M) tensor^L K to R-Hom(R-Hom(K, L), M), functorial in the three variables (statement lines 8964-8974). The proof (proof lines 8965-8995) chooses K-injective and K-flat representatives and defines the map through the evaluation map on the level of complexes, identifying the two sides with the required derived functors. H2: one construction with two inputs, written out in full.
